name: Shivam
bio: Visual artist working in portrait photography, cinematography, videography and video editing.
artist_vibe_summary: Shivam is a versatile visual artist based in Delhi, India, whose expertise spans portrait photography, cinematography, videography, and professional video editing. Operating with a multidimensional aesthetic, he demonstrates a strong capability to integrate captured moments and polished post-production into a cohesive visual style. His multidisciplinary approach highlights a refined technical foundation across both still and moving image mediums.

multimodal_questions.question: Are the transitions between clips smooth and purposeful?
Is the visual pacing matched effectively to the background audio/music?
Is the color grading consistent across different shots in the sequence?
Does the edit tell a clear narrative or maintain a cohesive theme?
Are graphical overlays or text (if any) professionally integrated?
Does the visual content prominently feature portrait photography with professional lighting and composition?
Does the footage demonstrate advanced cinematography techniques such as controlled depth of field, stable camera movement, and deliberate framing?
Are there examples of videography that capture dynamic live events or narrative sequences effectively?
Does the video editing showcase professional post-production work including seamless cuts, color grading, and pacing?
Does the portfolio successfully integrate portrait photography, cinematography, videography, and video editing into a cohesive visual style?
